summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K disclosing routine director/PDMR share transactions under the UK Market Abuse Regulation, converted to US equivalent of insider trading notifications. The filing covers DRIP acquisitions by CFO Kate Thomson and other executives, with individual transactions ranging from 4,887 to 9,744 shares at £4.58242 per share, on 1 July 2026. No corporate event, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic action is involved. The disclosure is purely regulatory compliance regarding insider holdings, not a special situation. What to watch: no market-moving implications; routine administrative filing.
